siteContent.heroSubheadline: Discover premium Pakistani fashion crafted with elegance, comfort and quality.
siteContent.address: Science College, Wahdat Road, Lahore, Pakistan.
siteContent.storeHours: Monday - Saturday: 11:00 AM - 10:00 PM | Sunday: 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM
siteContent.aboutText: Riwaayat Wear is a premier Pakistani fashion atelier rooted in the royal heritage of Lahore. We curate luxurious men and women shalwar kameez, handcrafted Jamawar waistcoats, and opulent unstitched ensembles. Every garment is cut from superfine fabrics and embellished with intricate hand embroidery, reflecting our motto: Timeless Tradition, Modern Style.
siteContent.shippingPolicy: Express delivery nationwide across Pakistan (3-5 business days). Free standard shipping on all orders above PKR 5,000.

products.name: Royal Obsidian Black Embroidered Shalwar Kameez
products.description: Crafted from 100% Giza Egyptian cotton with subtle tonal hand-embroidery along the mandarin band collar and cuffs. Tailored in a modern relaxed Pakistani silhouette with matching pleated shalwar.

products.name: Zarrin Ivory & Dabka Festive 3-Piece Suit
products.description: Exquisite champagne gold and ivory cream stitched ensemble featuring delicate zardozi and dabka needlework. Accompanied by a pure organza embroidered dupatta and tapered raw silk trousers.
products.fabric: Pure Raw Silk Shirt with Tissue Organza Dupatta

products.name: Shah Jahan Jamawar Brocade Waistcoat
products.description: Hand-tailored Jamawar brocade waistcoat with antique gold paisley motifs and custom embossed metal buttons. Designed to elevate any plain shalwar kameez for festive occasions.
products.fabric: Pure Silk Jamawar with Breathable Viscose Lining

products.name: Mehtab Noir Luxury Unstitched 3-Piece
products.description: Signature 3-piece unstitched luxury lawn ensemble with heavy tilla embroidery, embroidered organza border patches, dyed cotton trousers, and foil-printed pure chiffon dupatta.

products.name: Koh-i-Noor Classic White Wash & Wear Suit
products.description: Pure optic white Pakistani shalwar kameez tailored from wrinkle-resistant blended cotton wash-and-wear. Features immaculate thread detailing and horn-finished buttons.

products.name: Noor-e-Kashmir Velvet Embroidered Waistcoat
products.description: Micro-velvet black waistcoat finished with hand-crafted kora dabka along the ban collar and double jet welt pockets. The pinnacle of winter formal sophistication.

products.name: Gul-e-Maryam Handworked Organza Suit
products.description: Pastel pistachio and gold dabka embroidered kalidar frock with churidar pajama. Accented with mirrorwork borders and pure silk dupatta with scallop edging.
products.fabric: Pure Silk Chiffon with Silk Slip

products.name: Heritage Chikankari Luxury 3-Piece Unstitched
products.description: Intricate Kashmiri Chikankari needlework on pure cotton lawn shirt with digital printed silk dupatta and dyed cambric trousers. Ideal for summer and Eid festivities.
products.fabric: Fine Cotton Lawn with Silk Dupatta
